I will put some manure on the plot because I keep a few goats, and I will buy one bag of government fertilizer from the agro-dealer in town to help the maize grow. I plant the maize seed I kept from last year because the hybrid seeds are too expensive, and I do not have money for chemicals, so we will weed by hand. The rains will come soon, so I do not need to irrigate, and I will hire three days of labor for the heavy digging at the start.
